title: After the Earthquake
text:
A strong earthquake shook a small town near the sea last year. Many houses fell down, and people ran out into the street. The ground shook for almost one minute. Everyone was very scared.

Rescue teams came from the big city to help. They searched for people under the rubble. After three days, the town began to rebuild the houses. Children went back to school in a new building.

questions.text: How long did the ground shake?
Where did the rescue teams come from?
How did the people feel during the earthquake?
What can we guess about the town after three days?
options: It was moving to the sea

vocabulary.definition: a sudden shaking of the ground caused by movements under the earth
broken pieces of buildings after they have fallen down
to build something again after it has been destroyed

paragraph_translations: Um forte terremoto sacudiu uma pequena cidade perto do mar no ano passado. Muitas casas caíram, e as pessoas saíram correndo para a rua. O chão tremeu por quase um minuto. Todos estavam muito assustados.

Equipes de resgate vieram da cidade grande para ajudar. Elas procuraram pessoas debaixo dos escombros. Depois de três dias, a cidade começou a reconstruir as casas. As crianças voltaram para a escola em um prédio novo.
